decisions.reason: The charge-LED connector and resistor changes do not alter the battery NTC terminal, connector, function, or thermal-protection controller.
The source changes the charge-status LED circuit, not the battery electrical-protection controller, cutoff rules, or R7/R8 protection functions.
J_LED_CHG is a separate charge-LED connector and does not resolve or modify the J_BAT connector family, pin count, functions, part number, or unresolved pin order.
The source does not change the MT3608 enable GPIO, pull-down, default state, powered loads, or usage pattern.
The dedicated external charge-LED connector does not modify the existing J_PWR_POWER or J_PWR_SIGNAL interboard connectors or their pin assignments.
Adding a dedicated future charge LED does not replace or alter the existing SK6812 addressable-LED chain or its GPIO13 data interface.
R6 and the 270Ω charge-LED resistance are unrelated to the I2C pull-ups and retained zero-ohm series resistors.
The source adds a connector and LED circuit to the power board but does not add, remove, or merge any project board.
The charge-LED circuit changes do not alter the power board's four-layer stack.
The source introduces J_LED_CHG but specifies no placement, orientation, mounting-hole clearance, or access change for the battery and interboard connectors.
The explicit connector, resistor-value, and population directives necessarily change the assembly-ready power-board BOM and resolve R6's previously unknown specification.

source_message.text:
Regarding power board, I just need:
1\. Add J\_LED\_CHG (2-pin JST-GH) — CHGLED circuit with 270Ω resistor, D1 stays DNP
2\. Change R6 from 4.7kΩ to 270Ω, remove DNP
I figure out I will need that led in future anyway.

decisions.reason: The power-board charge-LED connector does not alter the dedicated sensor-board fanout role or its external sensor interfaces.
